title: Add HTML todo list and stats pages to Go middleware server
description: Brownfield Go task: extend the JSON todo server with two HTML-rendering endpoints using html/template with inline template strings.

task_spec.prompt:
Add two HTML-rendering handlers to the Go middleware server. All existing tests must still pass.

In a new file internal/handler/html.go:

  func HTMLTodoList(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
    — GET only (405 otherwise)
    — renders Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
    — page title: "Todo List"
    — shows all todos in a <table> with columns: ID, Title, Done
    — rows for done todos must have class="done" on the <tr>

  func HTMLStats(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
    — GET only (405 otherwise)
    — renders Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
    — page title: "Stats"
    — shows a <dl> with two entries: "Total" and "Done" counts

Use html/template with inline template strings (no external template files).
Both handlers read from the same package-level todos slice and mu used by todos.go.

Update cmd/server/main.go to register:
  mux.HandleFunc("/todos.html", handler.HTMLTodoList)
  mux.HandleFunc("/stats.html", handler.HTMLStats)

All 3 existing tests must still pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: GET /todos.html returns 200 with text/html content type
GET /todos.html includes todo titles in HTML table
Done todos have class="done" on their <tr>
GET /stats.html returns 200 with Total and Done counts
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `go test ./...` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
